pkgmetadata.longdescription: NeMo Evaluator is an open-source library for scalable, reproducible evaluation of AI language models. It provides benchmark environments, pluggable solver backends, an interceptor proxy for tracing model calls, and decision-grade scoring for LLMs. Supports a wide range of standard benchmarks via a FastAPI-based REST interface.
